examples.english: My father had heart surgery. It was a major operation lasting 6 hours, but I'm relieved it ended safely.

notes:
{手術|しゅじゅつ} refers to a surgical operation or surgery.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {手術|しゅじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to have/undergo surgery)
- {手術|しゅじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to perform surgery)
- {手術|しゅじゅつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (surgery succeeds)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手術|しゅじゅつ}⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (operating room)
- {手術|しゅじゅつ}⟦{台|だい}→台：13039_dai⟧ (operating table)
- {手術|しゅじゅつ}⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ (surgery cost)
- {手術|しゅじゅつ}⟦{後|ご}→後：noentry⟧ (post-surgery)
- ⟦{大|だい}→大：noentry⟧{手術|しゅじゅつ} (major surgery)
- ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧{手術|しゅじゅつ} (emergency surgery)
- ⟦{美容|びよう}→美容：00014_biyou⟧{手術|しゅじゅつ} / ⟦{整形|せいけい}→整形：09493_seikei⟧{手術|しゅじゅつ} (cosmetic surgery)
- ⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧{手術|しゅじゅつ} (heart surgery)

FORMS:
⟦オペ→オペ：noentry⟧ (from "operation") is commonly used in medical contexts: ⟦オペ→オペ：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to perform surgery)
